Present petition is for a direction to respondent authorities to consider the representation of the petitioner dated:24.01.2023 to pay the compensation as determined by this Court in MFA No.9852/2013 under Section 54(1) of the Land Acquisition Act.
The award under Land Acquisition Act is considered to be a decree capable of enforcement under the provisions of Code of Civil Procedure.

2. In that view of the matter more effective and efficacious remedy being available to petitioner,
reserving liberty to explore and initiate proceedings thereunder, petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
